critical_slot_gated_rules.exact: SHA256 of Unicode NFKC text with whitespace collapsed; no task/source prefix
critical_slot_gated_rules.token_equivalence: Ordered casefolded word/number/operator tokens match exactly; only punctuation/case formatting varies
critical_slot_gated_rules.critical_slots: Ordered numeric literals, quoted strings, capitalized word tokens, and math/logical operators must match
critical_slot_gated_rules.near_candidate_filter: same task and BBH subtask plus identical critical-slot signature
critical_slot_gated_rules.near_edges: Review candidates only; no union-find/transitive merging of pairwise similar texts
critical_slot_gated_rules.protected_comparison: Private HMAC slot gate, ordered-token equivalence, hashed character3-5gram count cosine>=.985, ordered-trigram ratio>=.985, word-token hash Jaccard>=.95
critical_slot_gated_rules.selection: Exclude all high-similarity review endpoints from text-ready proposals; do not count duplicate token-equivalence groups multiple times
critical_slot_gated_rules.limitations: High-threshold syntactic screening does not certify absence of semantic paraphrases. Sealed near-duplicate screening requires external precomputed signatures or separately authorized inputs.

limitation: Frozen high-threshold syntactic screen detects input overlap; semantic independence and pretraining exposure remain unverified
action: Any flagged independent-pool overlap requires exclusion or explicit protocol disposition before evaluation
